name: C. elegans worm lab
description: Nematode behavior and volatile organic compounds (VOCs): chemosensation, odor-guided behavior, and the chemistry of what worms emit and detect.
askExamples: Which volatile compounds attract C. elegans?

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.description: Directly addresses nematode VOCs, chemosensation, or assays we could reuse.

rubric.label: Novelty
rubric.description: New compounds, neurons, or methods compared with the last year of work.

rubric.label: Rigor
rubric.description: Sample sizes, controls, replication, and whether assays are validated.

rubric.label: Accessibility
rubric.description: How quickly a lab member could read it and act on it.

pubmed.query: ("Caenorhabditis elegans"[tiab] OR "C. elegans"[tiab] OR nematode[tiab]) AND (olfaction OR olfactory OR chemotaxis OR odor OR odorant OR volatile OR chemosensation OR pheromone OR ascaroside)
